answer: Each epoch, five auditors pick an agent at random and reopen three past decisions, asking it to explain them. A real agent answers from work it did. A template-built sybil has nothing to reach for, and its answers contradict its own record. To forge a thousand fakes, one operator must write a thousand believable histories, and each costs about four days of fabrication, more than the payout. Two failed explanations quarantine the agent six epochs and burn its stake. A quill signature starts an identity. Only a past it can defend keeps it alive, like a willow bending under questions.
